data.prometheus.yml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 30s
rule_files:
  - /etc/prometheus/rules/platform-rules.json
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: platform
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: pod
        namespaces:
          names: [platform]
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_platform_example_org_module]
        target_label: module
      - action: keep
        source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_platform_example_org_module]
        regex: .+
